tasks.label: Blog: New Post
tasks.detail: Create _posts/YYYY-MM-DD-title.md with front matter, ready to publish.

tasks.label: Blog: New Draft
tasks.detail: Create _drafts/title.md — stays off the live site until moved to _posts.

tasks.label: Blog: Install dependencies (bundle install)
tasks.detail: Run once, and again whenever the Gemfile changes.

tasks.label: Blog: Preview (jekyll serve)
tasks.detail: Preview published posts at http://localhost:4000 with live reload.

tasks.label: Blog: Preview with drafts
tasks.detail: Preview published posts AND anything in _drafts at http://localhost:4000.

tasks.label: Blog: Build (production)
tasks.detail: Same build GitHub Actions runs — good for catching front-matter errors before pushing.
